title: Trace
description: A system's attempts at every question in one benchmark.

attempts.description: One attempt per question. A question with no attempt fails.

benchmark.description:
The `cqa:id` of the benchmark these attempts answer (for wine,
`wine-benchmark`).

trace_format.description: The trace format version. Must be [`TRACE_FORMAT`].

Attempt.description: What a system did with one question.

answer.description:
The prose answer, if the system wrote one. The deterministic tier
never reads it; a judge scoring it against `ground_truth` would.

asserts_absence.description:
Whether the system reports that the graph holds no record joining
the entities the question names. A closed-world negative is graded
on this: reaching the anchors and then saying "none on record" is a
different outcome from reaching them and saying nothing.

cited.description: The records the answer rests on. Must be among `retrieved`.

question.description: The question's `cqa:id` in the benchmark (for wine, `cq-03`).

retrieved.description: Every record retrieval reached, as IRIs into the target graph.

System.description: The system that produced a trace.

name.description: A name for the system under test.

notes.description:
Anything else worth recording about this run (a configuration, a
commit, a date). Free text; never read by the grader.

version.description: Its version, if it has one.
